title: Favouring one side of the family
odia:
ଆପଣା ଭଉଣୀ ନ ପାଏ ଭାତଗୁଣ୍ଡା
ଶଳାଶାଳୀ ପାଇଁ ଥୁଆ କ୍ଷୀରମଣ୍ଡା ।
literal_meaning: One’s own sister gets no mouthful of rice, while milk cakes await the brothers- and sisters-in-law.
explanation: The contrast criticises conspicuous favour for one set of relatives while someone close goes without. It questions unequal care, not the worth of either relationship.
meaning_odia: ନିଜ ଭଉଣୀଙ୍କ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ଭାତ ନାହିଁ, ହେଲେ ଅନ୍ୟ ପକ୍ଷର ଆତ୍ମୀୟଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଭଲ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଯତ୍ନର ଏହି ଅସମାନ ବଣ୍ଟନକୁ କଥାଟି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ସମ୍ପର୍କର ଆଦର କରିବା ବେଳେ ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କ ମୂଳ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଅବହେଳିତ ରହୁଛି କି ନାହିଁ, ସେହି କଥା ମୁଖ୍ୟ।
usage_example: A host arranges expensive gifts for guests while ignoring a sibling’s urgent need. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The food contrast is imagery; no universal household custom is asserted.
